INVENTORY APP - LINUX
=====================

RUN:
  1. Double-click  run-web.sh  (or:  ./run-web.sh  in a terminal)
  2. Browser opens the app at http://localhost:8080

Requires python3 (preinstalled on most distros).
If the file is blocked:  chmod +x run-web.sh

NOTES
  - Your data is saved in the browser on THIS computer.
    (Use the Export buttons to back it up as Excel/PDF.)
  - Plug in a USB barcode scanner; it works like a keyboard.
